acceptances.reason: Outside the published closure. No published package depends on postcss; it is reached only through the private `site` package's build-time Vite. The advisory reads a `.map` file named by a `sourceMappingURL` comment in the stylesheet being compiled, and `site` compiles only stylesheets this repository writes.

Outside the published closure. No published package depends on js-yaml; it is reached only through the private `site` package, under `@tanstack/start-plugin-core`'s `xmlbuilder2`. The quadratic resolution needs attacker-supplied YAML containing `!!omap`, and the site build parses none.

Outside the published closure. No published package depends on nanoid; it is reached only through the private `site` package's build-time Vite, under postcss. The loop needs a caller asking a custom generator for a zero-length identifier, and postcss asks for a fixed non-zero length.

Outside the published closure, and no fix exists to take. `prisma` is a devDependency of the private `typescript/prisma` adapter tests; it enters this path only because `drizzle-orm` declares it as an optional peer, which pnpm resolves against that development copy. `@prisma/config` still pins deepmerge-ts 7.1.5 as of its 7.10.0 release, so there is no upstream version to move to.
